June, I couldn't set up the recurring 17:30 post. The scheduler rejected the job because the gateway needs credentials that aren't configured on my side. So nothing is scheduled, and no "Pod end of day" note will appear at 17:30 unless this is fixed.

The job I tried to create would run every weekday at 17:30 Chicago time, starting today. It would read only #strategic-pod and post one top-level "Pod end of day" note there listing that day's messages.

An admin needs to set up the gateway auth for the scheduler. Once that's done, tell me and I'll create the job. Until then, ask me in here and I'll post the day's digest by hand.
